capabilities: Create Asana tasks from selected text
Create Asana tasks from the current line
Authenticate with an Asana access token in settings
extras: README covers installation (including via the BRAT beta plugin) and access-token setup but does not document commands, settings, or usage examples beyond the core action.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send text from notes to Asana as tasks.
summary: Asana integration that creates an Asana task from the currently selected text or the line at the cursor in the editor.
